response.overview: Umi, a singer-songwriter, has just become a mother. In her urban flat, she tries to get the hang of life as a mum. But this is disrupted by chaos: noise from her upstairs neighbour, hustle and bustle, and unsolicited advice. Amid pumping, nappies and other people's expectations, Umi briefly loses herself. Slowly, she seeks the space to reconnect with her own feelings. With her ukulele, she begins turning her emotions into music and finds her own voice again.
response.title: Baby Majeur
